items.label: Smart Display Base
items.value: Unlike other thermometers that require an app to function, the P4’s display base provides real-time readings and lets you set temperatures directly on the device. A smart app is also available, giving you the best of both worlds.

items.label: Unlimited Range via Wi-Fi
items.value: Many wireless thermometers are restricted to Bluetooth to connect your phone with the base, but the ThermoMaven P4 features advanced 2.4GHz Wi-Fi connectivity. This lets you monitor your culinary creations from anywhere.

items.label: 100% Wireless Freedom
items.value: Kiss tangled wires goodbye with the ThermoMaven P4. Roam freely with Bluetooth long-range connectivity, linking seamlessly from the base to the probes.

items.label: 6-Sensor Accuracy
items.value: Equipped with 6 sensors (5 internal and 1 external), the precision of ThermoMaven P4 is NIST-certified, delivering ±0.5°F accuracy and 0.01°F resolution. You can confidently ensure your food is never undercooked or overcooked.

items.label: Four Ultra-Thin Probes
items.value: Allows you to monitor time and temperature for four different dishes at once. The ultra-thin design preserves the integrity of your proteins and retains their juices, ensuring perfectly cooked meat every time.

items.label: Effortless Cleanup
items.value: With a superior IPX8 waterproof rating, the ThermoMaven probes can be safely placed in the dishwasher after use. Enjoy your meal and relax with no hassle!

items.label: High-Temp Grilling
items.value: The wireless meat probes simultaneously track both the internal meat temperature (up to 221°F) and the ambient temperature (up to 752°F) for accurate cooking results.You can safely keep the probe in place, even while searing, for continuous temperature monitoring.

items.label: Charge Once, Cook All Day
items.value: Base charges in 2 hours for 24+ hours of continuous use. Probes charge 2 min for 2 hours work. Perfect your cooking every time.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Alarm, App Companion, High Accuracy, Large Display, Wi-Fi Support

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine Wash, Oven Safe, Wipe Clean
